I compared the possible arrangements by hand rather than with an exhaustive search. So 7 missed pairs is the best I found, but it is not proven to be the minimum. The plan below misses 7 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $143.09 (14,309 cents), across 9 paid periods.

**Fixed points:**
- From Nov 1 to Nov 7, Orbit and Northline are both already paid. That uses both slots, so nothing new can start before Nov 8.
- Northline's prepaid access (Nov 1–7) already covers Crooked Signal, so Northline needs no new period.
- Marquee carries none of the followed titles, so it is never needed.

**The January bottleneck:** Orbit (The Distant Atlas), Tidewell (The Northern Lantern) and Lumen (The Northern Kingdom and The Copper Signal) all have episodes starting Dec 30. With only two slots, something must be dropped. Two options were close:
- **Lumen waits for Orbit to end (Jan 29):** this misses 11 pairs.
- **Tidewell runs until Jan 7, Lumen starts Jan 8, Tidewell returns Jan 29:** this misses 6 pairs, so I chose it. The losses are:
  - Northern Lantern episodes 3 and 4 for Ada and Priya (4 pairs).
  - Northern Kingdom episode 1 for Eli and Priya (2 pairs).

**Later months:** From late January, Lumen holds one slot continuously until April. In the other slot, Tidewell is needed for Northern Lantern episodes 5–7 and again for The Paper Orchard (Mar 19–22, 7 pairs for Eli). A month of Orbit for Crooked Lantern (Eli, 1 pair) cannot fit between those two Tidewell periods. Dropping it is the cheapest loss, giving 7 missed pairs in total.

**Periods, checked against the rules:**

| Service | Start | Access through | Covers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tidewell | Nov 8 | Dec 7 | Glass Garden, Hollow Circuit |
| Orbit | Nov 29 | Dec 28 | Distant Atlas (continues prepaid access) |
| Tidewell | Dec 8 | Jan 7 | Northern Lantern episodes 1–2 |
| Orbit | Dec 29 | Jan 28 | Distant Atlas through episode 12 |
| Lumen | Jan 8 | Feb 7 | Northern Kingdom, Copper Signal |
| Tidewell | Jan 29 | late Feb | Northern Lantern episodes 5–7 |
| Lumen | Feb 8 | Mar 7 | Northern Kingdom, Copper Signal |
| Lumen | Mar 8 | Apr 7 | Northern Kingdom, Copper Signal |
| Tidewell | Mar 19 | Apr 18 | Paper Orchard |

- **Concurrency:** no day has more than two services with access.
- **Never paying twice:** each service's periods start exactly where the previous one ends, or later.
- **Date ambiguity:** "Jan 29 plus one month" has no Feb 29 in 2027. Whether that ends on Feb 28 or Mar 1, it does not affect any coverage or overlap.
